name: f2_spatial_three_axis_retrospective_review_v1
decision_rule: Reuse the existing seven-axis default-bank guard: validation pooled macro-F1 must not fall and pooled log loss must not rise on each available matched axis, with at least one strict improvement. Final is descriptive only. This review is retrospective and cannot create a prospective test set.
boundary: The axes reuse inspected public recordings and overlap other project studies. This three-axis F2 review does not replace the earlier seven-axis decision, prove independent generalization, or evaluate the user's 250 Hz device.
